visual.name: bfusionSunkCostDecisionBoard
visual.description: Quadrant decision board: every project plotted by Budget Consumed (X) vs Project Health / Value Confidence (Y). Splits the portfolio into Healthy Delivery Zone, Failing Early (Pause & Re-plan) and Sunk Cost Trap (Terminate). Right-side Recommended Action card surfaces the worst offender, the recoverable budget freed by killing it, and smart-insight callouts. What-if sliders move the budget / health cut-offs in real time.
